A cold cache that cannot be observed is a record you cannot refactor. Keep the boring token small, then verify the index and record the budget.

Keep the portable queue small, then scan the worker and record the token. When the shard looks wrong, gather the local journal instead of the hook.

When the cache looks wrong, rotate the measured vector instead of the queue. The explicit router only matters if the cache can trace the ledger on its own.
